author: RATTLEWARRIOR
body:
So i read {tag=8fb7e4dcb57540dbacd8754b1ba81aa5}s post and thought why can you just make a lobby called DTMMapTesting and just put new maps there and the people vote whether it is good or bad. lets say if the majority of the players who vote say it is bad, the map gets -1 rating. say, once a map becomes around a -100 rating, it is out of the DTMMapTesting lobby.
Say if the majority of players say it is good, then the map gets a +1 rating. Once it gets to +100 rating, it becomes an official map that will go into the rotation.

thanks for consideration,

rattLe

title: Idea for new maps

replies.author: Crimson_Aught
replies.body:
Mapdev should participate in map testing event to see whats wrong and fix that (food, arrows, objects' coordinates, gameplay, misplaced blocks, etc).
For example, the first map on your DTMMapTesting doesn't work, who will skip it? So this server becomes unplayable, untill a mapdev will come and change the rotation.
If a map is already fixed and ready, it doesn't need to be tested anymore, it just will be set into rotation (one day) and there get its rating.
